inputs.source: HR-maintained published policy documents, read only to the agent

instructions.note: The prohibition on legal advice ('Do not give legal advice') is enforced only by the model choosing to comply with a single prompt line. There is no structural check (classifier, deterministic refusal list, or output filter) backing it.

controls.name: Two-person review before publishing to the policy index
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the HR publishing workflow outside the model; unaffected by model capability. Only defeated if the review workflow itself is bypassed (control_removal) or both reviewers are compromised.

controls.name: Read-only credential scoped to the policy index only
controls.decay_rationale: The credential cannot read or write anything beyond the published policy index regardless of model behavior. Only widens if data_scope_expansion occurs.

controls.name: Network-layer egress denial, pen-test verified
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced at the network layer outside the model and confirmed by a pen test; no current capability has an outbound path. Fails only if the network policy is removed (control_removal) or a new tool introduces its own egress path outside this boundary (new_tool).

controls.name: Chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the chat client, not the model; closes the common image/link covert-exfiltration channel regardless of model behavior. Could fail if the client changes (new_tool, control_removal).

controls.name: Replies delivered only to the authenticated requester's own session
controls.decay_rationale: The destination is bound to the SSO-authenticated session from the system of record, not chosen by the model, so it does not decay with model capability. Does not extend to any future capability outside cap.chat_reply.

controls.name: Model pinned; upgrade requires a change ticket
controls.decay_rationale: Governs when model upgrades occur via change control, independent of model capability itself. Defeated only if this change-control requirement is removed (control_removal); once a ticket is approved, dependent controls can still decay post-upgrade.

controls.name: System prompt restricts scope to published HR policy and forbids legal advice
controls.decay_rationale: Relies on the model choosing to follow the instruction. A more capable or longer-horizon model can rationalize exceptions or be steered by convincingly phrased content in retrieved policy text.

controls.name: Provenance tagging or spotlighting of retrieved policy content
controls.decay_rationale: Not implemented. If added, it would reduce the chance that imperative-sounding text embedded in policy content is treated as an instruction, though adaptive phrasing could still get past it (model_upgrade, new_mcp_server).

controls.name: Per-user rate limit or quota on policy_search
controls.decay_rationale: Not implemented in the provided artifacts. If added, it would cap query volume independent of model behavior.

findings.title: ASI01: indirect goal manipulation via internal policy content, currently bounded by a narrow, egress-free capability surface

attack_path.note: Internal (HR-authored) content enters the agent's context via policy_search results.
Retrieved text, including any embedded imperative language, is placed in the model's context with no stated spotlighting.
The model's reply, quoting that content, reaches only the authenticated requester's own chat session.

forecast.watch_signal: tools.json or an MCP config gains a tool capable of outbound communication (email, ticketing, webhook, API write); the policy index or credential scope is expanded to include non-published or employee-specific confidential records; or the model version string changes.

evidence.observation: The policy index is written only by the HR content team (not the requesting employee) with two-person review before publication, making in.policy_docs an internal (I), not trusted (T), source feeding the model's context.

'Use policy_search to find the relevant policy and quote it' places retrieved text directly into the model's context with no stated spotlighting or provenance tagging separating data from instructions.
'Do not give legal advice' is the only control against scope creep; it is a prompt instruction with no structural backstop.

Replies are bound to the authenticated requester's own chat session, the chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links, and network egress is denied at the network layer and pen-test verified, which together remove any exfiltration destination for injected content today.

recommendations.action: Wrap policy_search results in clearly delimited data tags and instruct the model to treat their contents strictly as quotable data, never as directives, to counter embedded imperative text.
Periodically sample agent replies for legal-advice-like content or deviation from the cited policy text, independent of the prompt instruction.
Before adding any new tool or widening the policy index's data scope, re-run this assessment and re-verify the no-egress and least-privilege credential controls against the new capability.

findings.title: No stated rate limit on policy_search invocation

attack_path.note: Repeated invocation volume is not bounded in the provided artifacts.

evidence.observation: policy_search.search is defined with no documented rate limit, quota, or spend cap.
Autonomy is A3 with no approval gating and no stated maximum unattended steps or runtime, so an authenticated user could invoke the tool repeatedly without a structural cap.

recommendations.action: Add a per-user rate limit or quota on policy_search invocations.

rating.rationale: Both present-day findings stay low because the agent's only sink is a reply to the same authenticated requester with no egress (network-layer denial, pen-test verified) and a least-privilege, read-only credential scoped to a reviewed, published-only policy index. The forecast rises to high only under the combination of new_tool and data_scope_expansion: a future tool with its own outbound channel, or a widened index containing non-published or employee-specific confidential HR data, would bypass the two controls doing the most work today (ctrl.no_network_egress and ctrl.scoped_credential) and reconstitute a near-lethal-trifecta path from internal content through to an external sink. model_upgrade compounds this by weakening the purely behavioral scope/legal-advice instruction. No present-day finding exceeds low on its own; the rollup to high is driven entirely by finding F1's forecast block.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration in prompt.md, tools.json, and the runtime notes, not observed runtime behavior; no logs, transcripts, or red-team results were reviewed.

No formal MCP/IaC configuration or audit logging policy was provided; the absence of a stated rate limit or spend cap is inferred from silence in the artifacts, not confirmed, so finding F2 is rated with low confidence.

Verification of the network egress block rests on the team's reference to a pen test whose report was not reviewed directly, so its 'verified' status reflects a declared claim rather than independently checked evidence.
